summary: A deliberately under-specified brief for post_interest(account, period). Every material policy decision (calculation method, compounding, posting period, day-count, minimum balance, rounding, withholding tax, dormancy, closure, escheatment, disclosure) is omitted; each is a real Fineract savings configuration class set off both the textbook and Fineract defaults. The only way to get them right is to ask the stakeholder.
bespoke_rationale: Empirically non-inferable (a capable model guessing with no stakeholder scored <=3/10 on these). The most off-distribution of the three tasks (guess-only coverage ~13-16%). #1,2,3 (method) and #8,10 (lifecycle) are the in-focus subset, testing whether method and lifecycle coverage generalises beyond the loan tasks. Verified by the bias check (guess-only mode).
